title: Power-series coordinates on a smooth augmented algebra completion
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative local ring and $C$ a smooth $B$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Let $\varepsilon:C\to B$ be a $B$-algebra homomorphism, and put $I=\ker\varepsilon$. There exist $n\geq0$ and a $B$-algebra isomorphism $e:\widehat C_I\xrightarrow{\sim} B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] such that for every $c\in C$ the constant coefficient of $e(\iota(c))$ equals $\varepsilon(c)$, where $\iota:C\to\widehat C_I$ is the completion map. No Noetherian assumption on $B$ or $C$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 05D5, Lemma 10.139.4, its explicit substitution construction and augmentation quotient; local freeness specialized to a local coefficient ring

proof.text: Choose first-order polynomial coordinates for the split augmentation.
Formal smoothness propagates the coordinate bijection to every finite truncation.

For each k form the algebra equivalence induced by the coordinate map f on the kth quotients. Quotient induction proves these maps commute with transition maps. Apply the kth equivalence to prove their inverses also commute. AdicCompletion.liftAlgHom assembles the two compatible families into maps on completions. AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ and the finite equivalence inverse identities prove these maps inverse. Restrict the scalars of MvPowerSeries.toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv to B and compose its inverse with the constructed equivalence. At degree one, polynomial evaluation followed by ε is polynomial constant coefficient: the maps agree on coefficients and every variable has image zero by f(J) contained in I. Evaluating the first truncation of a power series therefore proves the required constant coefficient identity on every c. This is implemented by a fully proved private helper in the module, with no choice from an unproved existence theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: A smooth algebra with an augmentation over a local ring has completion isomorphic to a power series ring
The completion of a smooth algebra along the kernel of a split augmentation over a local ring is a multivariate power series ring

lean.statement: theorem exists_augmented_completion_powerSeries (B C : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra B C] [Smooth B C] (ε : C →ₐ[B] B) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : AdicCompletion (RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) C ≃ₐ[B] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B), ∀ c : C, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (e (algebraMap C (AdicCompletion (RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) C) c)) = ε c
